input_policy: Previously exported WAVs are read directly; raw comes from original raw WAV; GT comes from original M4A
duplicate_controls: Redundant loudness-matched controls from listening sets are not separate filter schemes; original raw is the common raw scheme
gt_decode: FFmpeg stereo mean, anti-aliased resampling to 16000 Hz
pcm_scaling: SciPy PCM32 / 2**31, including left-aligned PCM24 exports
normalization: Divide each spectrum by its own integrated 500-2000 Hz energy; comparison is spectral shape, not sound pressure
displayed_smoothing: 1/12 octave total width, arithmetic mean of linear PSD within +/-1/24 octave around each native FFT bin; same rule for every curve
original_spectra: Unsmoothed and smoothed values both available in spectra_all_parameters.csv
aggregate: Equal-weight per-recording median; IQR = 25th-75th percentiles across seven recordings; no inferential test
pairing: Same speaker and text per number, separate takes; no time alignment or transfer function inference
